app TypedAuthorizedReads
Given
 role auditor
 Entry { count:int=1, secret:text="sensitive" }
 policy Entry read=owner
 policy Entry read=auditor fields=count
When
 crud Entry by=owner fields=count
 ## The aggregate sums authorized entries, using their native integers.
 scenario total() -> int by=public
  do
   return sum(Entry as entry select entry.count)
 ## Authorized projection omits secret for auditors, even inside native handlers.
 scenario hidden() -> bool by=public
  do
   return all(Entry as entry,entry.secret=="sensitive")
 ## Authorized model reads include this invocation's provisional creation.
 scenario staged(count:int) -> int by=owner
  do
   create Entry {count=count} as entry
   return sum(Entry as visible select visible.count)
 ## Numeric filters evaluate native projected integers, preserving each viewer's grants.
 scenario filtered(minimum:int) -> int by=public
  do return sum(Entry as entry where entry.count>=minimum select entry.count)
 scenario filteredSecret() -> int by=public
  do return count(Entry as entry where entry.secret=="sensitive")
 ## Later own writes must not change the query-time overlay used by its read guard.
 scenario filteredStaged(count:int,accept:bool) -> int by=owner
  do
   create Entry {count=count} as entry
   let selected=Entry as visible where visible.count==count
   set entry {count=entry.count+1}
   require accept
   return sum(selected as visible select visible.count)
 ## Admission remains public: losing a read grant must void even an empty selection.
 scenario filteredEffect(minimum:int) -> int by=public
  do
   let selected=Entry as entry where entry.count>=minimum
   create Entry {count=5} as marker
   return count(selected)
Then
